goal: Ship an RPG Maker XP RPG with best-in-class quality: AI-friendly MER -> Functional Spec -> Technical Spec -> Development -> Local executable tests (Act 1) -> Steam publication (Act 4) -> Post-launch improvements.
principles: Data first: canonical sources live in DATA/; README is operational guidance only.
Each adjustment must move the project forward along the delivery chain (MER -> Specs -> Dev -> Build/Test -> Release).
Prefer AI-parsable artifacts (CSV/JSON/YAML) for governance and specs; keep HUMAN views as read-only.

ACT_1.name: Local executable for tests
ACT_1.milestone_gate: A playable local build exists; core loop validated; content baseline for Act 1 complete.

ACT_4.name: Steam publication
ACT_4.milestone_gate: Release candidate shipped to Steam; store assets complete; QA checklist passed; legal/IP checks completed.

stages.name: MER ai-friendly
stages.purpose: Define the Minimal Executable Requirements (MER) as atomic, testable, AI-parsable requirements.
outputs: Prioritized MER backlog for Act 1 scope
Traceable MER identifiers referenced by specs
stages.gate: MER items for the next scope (e.g., Act 1) are defined, ranked, and traceable.

stages.name: Functional specification ai-friendly
stages.purpose: Translate MER items into player-facing behaviors, UX flows, rules, and acceptance tests.
stages.gate: Functional spec covers all in-scope MER items and defines measurable acceptance criteria.

stages.name: Technical specification ai-friendly
stages.purpose: Map functional specs into RGSS/Ruby implementation tasks, data changes, and test hooks.
outputs: Data tables affected; scripts/modules; performance constraints
stages.gate: Technical spec provides enough detail to implement without ambiguity and lists impacted data artifacts.

stages.name: Game development
stages.purpose: Implement RGSS + data changes; integrate assets; iterate with test builds.
stages.gate: Features pass local tests and match acceptance criteria.

stages.name: Local executable build (Act 1 tests)
stages.purpose: Generate a local playable build to validate the core loop and content baseline for Act 1.
stages.gate: Act 1 local build exists and is validated against MER + specs.

stages.name: Steam publication (Act 4)
stages.purpose: Ship the game to Steam with store assets, QA sign-off, and compliance checks.
stages.gate: Act 4 publication completed; post-launch backlog created.

stages.name: Post-launch improvements
stages.purpose: Prioritize and deliver improvements and content updates after release.
stages.gate: Continuous; each iteration produces at least one new improvement item.

analysis_phase_must.capture_location: LOG_AJUSTES.FuturasMelhorias and/or new AJ backlog items

notes: This roadmap is governance; implementation artifacts (RGSS scripts, RMXP project files, executables) may live outside this data bundle.
External reference PDFs/EPUBs are temporary: extract AI-only text and keep only reusable images long-term.
